ios.desc:
Do you oversleep? Miss classes? Fail to hear your alarm when it matters the most? 

Then you need an alarm clock that won’t quit until you are wide awake. We’ve created the perfect alarm sound¹ for a heavy sleeper that is impossible to miss. You have to solve multiple-choice math questions to shut it off. 

That’s right, you will be wide awake with no possibility of falling back to sleep.

*** Our Math Mission ***
Solve multiple-choice math problems in order to kickstart your brain and shut off the alarm. You will not be able to stop the loud and annoying sound without solving the equations. The questions will continue until we know you are bright-eyed and bushy-tailed.

* ALL FEATURES FOR FREE *

*** Alarm Features ***
- Interactive wake-up technology that works
- Impossible to mute
- Use it anywhere
- Crazy loud ringtones for heavy sleepers and night owls
- Procedural Ringtones¹ to never sleep through any alarm again
- Multiple, repeating alarms
- Lockable alarms to prevent yourself from cheating
- Sharing a room? The optional 10s snooze will help

*** Motivational Features ***
- Bedtime Reminder
- Bedtime Enforcer
- Morning Routine

*** Totally Customizable ***
- Dark mode to help you power down at night
- Bright alarms
- Customizable color themes and alternative app icon colors
- Bedside Clock with changeable clock face


*** Impossible to Mute ***
With ringtones designed to wake you up, our app comes with self composing¹ alarm sounds that are impossible to sleep through. 

*** Randomizable Ringtone Playlists ***
Wake up to your music, mix in ringtones with the songs you love, and let Siri talk you out of bed. 

*** The Motivational Alarm Clock ***
Turn your phone into a motivational tool that helps you get sleep, rest, replenish, and wake up in time. Get your morning routine done without a second thought.

*** For Students Everywhere ***
We want you to excel as a student. Our math alarm clock is designed to do just that, helping you to develop sleep habits that work for you.

Labeled as student’s ‘most annoying alarm clock,’ watch your mornings change instantly, guaranteed. It’s time to take back control!

*** Testimonials ***
